question: Which Magic: The Gathering Standard card (non-foil paper version released in its original set) that was banned at the same time as Oko, Thief of Crowns (including Oko, Crown of Thorns) had the highest price decrease from its all-time high to its all-time low?

history.name: MTG_StandardFormatHistory_Expert
history.content:

- We must determine, among cards banned on the same date as Oko, Thief of Crowns, which non-foil paper original-set printing had the largest drop from its all-time high to its all-time low.
- Plan:
  1) Confirm the Standard ban date and the full list of cards banned simultaneously.
  2) Ensure we are using the original set non-foil paper versions only.
  3) Gather historical price data for each card's all-time high and all-time low.
  4) Compute absolute price decrease (High minus Low) and select the largest.
  5) Document results with sources and ban date.
